title: Criss Cross Crash
summary: Criss Cross Crash or Criss Cross Crash Set is the name of many Track sets that have been used in various years. As the name suggests, these tracks test the limits of Hot Wheel cars in Criss Crossing situations. The tracks usually are a four curves, each meeting in the center to be boosted by a booster, with the objective to cross through the traffic safely.

title: Space Patrol
summary:
200px
Space Patrol is a very short lived series of space ship vehicles that came out in 1995. These crafts where big scale toys that would come with figurines to create whatever space theme adventure you wanted. Three toys where planned for the line, but only one of them was released; the Space Patrol Command Center (Toy# 93180)
